comment: OA controller profiles for the MENU poller (Web Gamepad API). Controller Identity arc Phase 2. Indices are Web-Gamepad-API RAW indices (buttons[] / axes[]). For pads whose SDL gamecontrollerdb button indices align with the Web raw indices (verified per-pad), entries are derived directly from SDL gamecontrollerdb. A profile is applied ONLY when the browser reports a non-standard mapping ('' rather than 'standard'); standard pads already arrive canonical. Keyed by device-key (see deviceKey.ts). Button names are CANONICAL (south/east/west/north = SDL/Xbox positions, a/b/x/y mapping lives in controllerProfiles.ts). DPad is handled by the runtime HAT detector when the pad reports it as a HAT axis; set hatAxis to seed that axis explicitly. Phase 3's wizard appends entries here; a later runtime override layer (appDataDir) will merge over this bundled seed.
